description: Act on one account health insight by id (from get_account_health): dismiss hides it for good, snooze hides it for snoozeDays (default 7, up to 90), resolve marks it fixed (it reopens if the next check still finds it), reopen brings back a snoozed or resolved one. Requires sequences:write.

action.description: What to do with the insight.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

snoozeDays.description: Days to snooze, only with action snooze. Defaults to 7.

name: update_account_health_insight

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_account_health_insight` MCP tool.

insight.description: The updated insight with its new status and snoozedUntil.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
